review_method: Direct web.open inspection of eight new Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org item pages: seven Likkutei Sichos pages and one Kehot-published Chassidic discourse. Original Hebrew/Yiddish body passages were inspected, not only titles or search snippets. One existing item identity (AID 6436855) was enriched in place with a second proposition from a separate original-Hebrew passage. A Hebrewbooks PDF viewer was inaccessible through the available public reader; the run switched to accessible Chabad.org item pages. AID 4557806 was inspected but withheld because the publisher labels it an adaptation of two separate talks (Vayishlach and Vayeishev 5746), not a single independent source event.
